A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the model can learn the notion of object continuity from a few examples of each object, and the learned knowledge can transfer to novel objects and even novel objects in completely new categories.

the transfer of object persistency to novel objects suggests that the notion of persistency is abstract and generalizable, and that the modification of distance metric in the view-manifolding of object representations is a key mechanism in the development of object recognition, as well as similarity judgment.

The main takeaway from our work is that

the notion of object persistency can be used to train deep networks to perform similarity judgment, and this ability is not specific to a particular set of trained objects, but can be generalized to novel objects and even novel artificial objects.
the notion of object persistency is an important factor that can be used to improve similarity judgment of novel objects.
